911792864.accepts_evidence: Grants are competitive but open only to AFA member organizations; a nonprofit must first join AFA's member network ($300 a year for a 501(c)(3)) to be eligible (https://alzfdn.org/find-a-member/grant-information/ ; https://alzfdn.org/membership/).
911792864.contact: grants@alzfdn.org (applications); membership@alzfdn.org (membership); 866-232-8484; 322 Eighth Avenue, 16th Floor, New York, NY 10001
911792864.deadlines: Bi-Annual Grant 2026: spring March 20, 2026 and fall September 25, 2026 (5:00 pm EST; not accepted more than 30 days early). Brodsky Innovation Grant: August 14, 2026. All 2026 dates have passed; 2027 dates not yet posted on the pages read.
911792864.eligibility: AFA nonprofit member organizations in good standing with dues paid, providing direct care or services to people with dementia; Bi-Annual Grant also requires at least one year of service delivery. Government and public safety agencies may join; Project Lifesaver grant requires PLI membership too. A grantee waits one calendar year before reapplying for the same grant.
911792864.grant_range_stated: Brodsky Innovation Grant $25,000 (one per year); Bi-Annual Grant $6,000; Berg Respite Care Grant $6,000; Project Lifesaver Grant $6,000.
911792864.how_to_apply: Join as a nonprofit member, then email the typed, fillable PDF application for the chosen grant to grants@alzfdn.org with the grant name in the subject line. Incomplete or handwritten applications are disqualified.
911792864.name: Alzheimer's Foundation of America
911792864.not_funded: Bi-Annual Grant: costs not needed for the program, salary increases as the sole reason for a request, membership fees, costs outside the grant period.
911792864.notes: Realistic route for an aging-services nonprofit with a dementia or caregiver program: pay the $300 membership (cycle runs September 1 to August 31), then apply for the $6,000 Bi-Annual or Respite Care grant next spring. The site still carries a stale 2020 Fall Bi-Annual page showing $5,000; the 2026 form says $6,000. The current Bi-Annual and Respite pages could not be opened by the tool, so respite grant dates are not recorded.
911792864.page_dated: 2026 application forms; Brodsky page modified October 26, 2026
priorities: Programs and services for people affected by Alzheimer's and related dementias
